messages:
lina-sales: FYI NimbusHealth POC is spiking 429s during hour-long load tests. Demo is in 3 hours, they're worried.
chris-support: Can you share the exact 429 body and which endpoint? Also any client concurrency settings?
lina-sales: They hit /v1/completions mostly. Sample response (redacted):
```json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "code": "per_route_burst",
  "route": "/v1/completions",
  "retry_after": 8,
  "request_id": "req-9f4b"
}
```
omar-eng: That code maps to the per-route burst limiter. Their trial tenant policy uses a 600/min burst and their test opened ~50 concurrent short-lived requests. Two paths: increase per-route burst for the tenant for the demo window, or add client-side concurrency cap + backoff. We can also add a short global grace for trial tenants but prefer targeted bump.
pete-oncall: I can apply a temporary per-route burst raise to 1800 for the tenant for 6 hours. Need thumbs-up from sales.
lina-sales: Please apply. We'll tell them it's temporary and ask them to reduce concurrency in prod.
quota-bot: Quota change requested: tenant=nimbus-health, route=/v1/completions, burst=1800, duration=6h, id=Q-20260321-44
quota-bot: Change applied and active. Expires at 1843433111.
lina-sales: Re-running their script now. chris-support: while they're running, can you confirm whether embeddings traffic could collide with completions caps? omar-eng: Embeddings hit a different route (/v1/embeddings) and have separate per-route burst caps, but both draw from the same tenant token budget. So you can see per-route 429s even with token budget headroom.
chris-support: Usage dashboard shows tenant token usage at 9% this month, so token budget not the issue.
lina-sales: Stress run completed — zero 429s in the last 10 minutes. Demo should be safe.
omar-eng: For POC guidance to send back: 1) set client max_concurrency <= 12 for the demo, 2) implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After header, 3) prefer keep-alive connections to reduce connection churn, 4) if sustained QPS needed, request a presales quota increase ahead of demo.
lina-sales: I'll forward those steps and note the temporary bump. thanks all :pray:
